taste.name: One metallic accent carries the national identity
taste.trigger: When a federal brand had to signal 'official UAE' without flag-colour clutter
taste.decision: Chose a single desaturated gold (#92722A) for CTAs, highlighted headline words and badges over the red/green/black flag palette
taste.reason: Gold reads as institutional and calm. Flag colours compete with status colours (red = error, green = success) that a service UI needs.
evidence: gold on Documentation CTA, Guidelines outline button, 'design'/'system' headline words
flag colours appear only in the logo ring

taste.name: Heavy display headings, quiet body
taste.trigger: When the hero had to carry authority in one line
taste.decision: Chose Inter 800 at 58px with -1.45px tracking for headings over a uniform single-weight scale, with Roboto 16-18px for everything else
taste.reason: Dense black headlines anchor the eye fast. Body text at 18px/27px with a 607px max-width stays readable for long guidance text.

taste.name: Bordered cards over shadowed cards
taste.trigger: When grouping timeline entries and resources
taste.decision: Chose 1px light borders with 12-16px radii and almost no drop shadow over elevated shadow cards
taste.reason: Flat bordered cards keep a document-like, printable feel suited to government guidance. Elevation is saved for the floating header.
evidence: timeline cards: white, 1px border; active card gets a cream fill instead of a shadow

taste.name: Restraint: no photography in the hero
taste.trigger: When a national design system site could have used skyline imagery
taste.decision: Chose a faint radial colour wash plus a greyed UI mockup over a full-bleed photo
taste.reason: The product is the components. Showing a mock interface sets expectations better than tourism imagery, and keeps contrast high for the headline.
evidence: hero background is #FCFCFC with blurred warm/green radial glows
mockup browser frame below the fold
